## Body

ROUND 1 performance verdict: PASS-WITH-NOTES.
Subject: pr:320
Head: 5c219c0b34c1f2e3e2253e68bbf96f8fca1a9631

The gap-storm rate brake is genuine; there is no new periodic quiet-fleet tick or process-launch site. Held decisions add one durable event publication when their action is Told/Pending. Renewal retries use incoming heartbeats, not a new retry task. No demonstrated normal-use resource-cost breach blocks this head. The PR's renewal retry cost should include the repeated F260 queue transaction, and the ten-second cap must remain scoped to gap reconciliation, not all recovery work.

Verified cost model:

| Work | Rate and scaling |
|---|---|
| Gap reconciliation | One initial scan, then no next scan until at least10s AFTER the preceding scan COMPLETES. The start-to-start interval is therefore at least10s plus prior scan duration. In a sustained storm, at most0.1 full scans/s,6/min after startup; no periodic scan when gaps are absent. One one-shot sleep deadline per recovered gap; expired deadlines complete immediately, and completion refreshes the cutoff, avoiding an overdue-deadline spin. |
| Scan reads | One live-Copilot roster call, then outstanding() per native seat N. That spine call uses FOUR indexed LIMIT1 seeks, one schema PRAGMA and read-snapshot begin/rollback, not one SQL statement. At the storm ceiling: at most0.4N seek statements/s,0.1N schema checks/s and0.1N read snapshots/s, plus roster and conditional decision work. |
| Live lapse events | Existing subscribed-event delivery remains uncapped by the ten-second brake. A delivered lapse also checks outstanding() with four seeks before deciding. The existing follower receives/clones total broadcast events before filtering; no new subscriber was added. No claim that all recovery reads are limited to one scan/10s. |
| Failed renewed-edge retry | The existing native heartbeat supplies the trigger. Default lease60s/divisor3 recommends20s between heartbeats, normally3 attempts/min per affected seat. This is a client recommendation, not a server-side request-rate limit. No incoming heartbeat means no retry. |
| Complete merged retry | While the lapsed mark remains, every renewing heartbeat validates the recipient, calls recover_held, then tries the renewed event. Even after all bodies were returned, recover_held_native_deliveries performs its schema read and queue BEGIN IMMEDIATE/failed-history SELECT/COMMIT. A matched hold additionally gets its guarded UPDATE, payload decode and separately committed outcome. The edge is another spine-write attempt. All run under the native lock; "one spine write per failed write" omits this repeated queue work. |
| Told/Pending decision | One added EventBus.publish and spine write transaction, plus a small action/at payload and broadcast to existing subscribers. After a successful held fact, later checks spare that lapse; failed persistence logs an error and can be re-attempted on future event/reconcile work, not on a new timer. remembered() still reads only acting AUTH_RECOVERY_KIND, so the30min window is not refreshed by a held fact. |

Sources: auth_recovery.rs:570-611,626-739; delivery/mod.rs:389-393,490-519,577-611,962-982; store/spine.rs:64-65,267-275,367-395. The full scan remains serial, so there is no scheduled scan backlog. The existing roster selection and eligible remedies still have their own row/transport costs. "No new launch" does not erase inherited restart/control/registration launches or the existing counted liveness fallback.

Non-blocking notes:
1. Correct complete retry accounting to include the empty/repeated F260 queue transaction and recipient-history scan. Bodies already returned to pending are not held again merely because the audit mark is reinserted; recovery's state/deadline guards remain.
2. Retain the distinction between successful eventual renewal persistence and immediate persistence. Until another heartbeat successfully publishes the edge, the stale spine fact can remain. A gap scan can run at10s while the normal heartbeat recommendation is20s. This timing nuance was sent to the separate correctness reviewer for the dropped/undecided-lapse ordering; this performance verdict does not clear that review.
3. Keep gap/pass/native-seat count and durations in an authorized AFTER receipt. The source bound and exact-head CI establish the limiter's shape, not its numerical CPU saving under live storm traffic.
